description: Lanka Samasamaja Party and Another v. Dayananda Dissanayake, The Commissioner General of Elections and Others Lanka Samasamaja Party and Another v. Dayananda Dissanayake, The Commissioner General of Elections and Others View More before Hon. Sathya Hettige (P/CA), J.
parties: Lanka Samasamaja Party and Another v. Dayananda Dissanayake, The Commissioner General of Elections and Others Lanka Samasamaja Party and Another v. Dayananda Dissanayake, The Commissioner General of Elections and Others View More
keywords: The Petitioner\'s nomination paper for the Kuchchaveli Pradeshiya Sabha local election was rejected in terms of Section 31(1)(a) of the Local Authorities Election Ordinance as it was delivered by another candidate rather than the Authorised Agent, contrary to Section 28(5). Held - delivery by the Authorized Agent is mandatory; presence alone was insufficient. Applications were dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
